Name: Igor's Anime Portraits for Gus and Linus
Author: IGor1B
Description:
This is my seventeenth mod posted on Nexus and there are still many shortcomings. If I receive your support, I promise to improve the quality of the portraits.
AI-generated portrait
Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 
OR
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] (optional)
You can use portraits to use with Romanceable Gus and Linus mods such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10206]Looking For Love[/url],[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/366]Siv's Marriage Mod[/url], …
[img]https://i.ibb.co/dDJ9TJ1/image.png[/img]
- Install the latest version of SMAPI
- Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19589]Igor's Anime Portraits for SDV NPCs[/url] and required mods into your \Stardew Valley\Mods folder
- Download and Unzip the zip file 
- Drag and drop folder named Igor's AnimePortraits into your \Stardew Valley\Mods folder
- Replace
